description: This line plot illustrates the relationship between BLEU scores and the length of a gold prefix for two different conditions. The x-axis, labeled "the length of gold prefix," features a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with numeric tick marks spaced at intervals of 5. The y-axis, labeled "BLEU," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 23 to 29 with tick marks at intervals of 1, accompanied by dashed horizontal grid lines. The plot contains two lines. The first line, representing an obscured legend entry, is a dashed blue line with open circular markers. It begins at a value of approximately 24.6 at x=0, experiences a sharp decline to its lowest point of roughly 23.7 at x=1, and then exhibits a general upward trend, reaching approximately 25.9 at x=10 and concluding at a peak value of approximately 28.1 at x=20. The second line, labeled "Inconsistency: wait-9," is a solid orange line with solid red square markers. It starts at approximately 25.1 at x=0, rises to a peak of roughly 26.1 at x=6, and then gradually fluctuates downward to a low of approximately 25.1 at x=14 and x=15, before rising again to end at approximately 25.9 at x=20.
